summary:
The four plots are all flat-roofed and placed on the # cells. The ITB is a 50x50 shaft with chamfered corners, a bronze grid of brown_terracotta and brown stained glass, and a three-step crown with lit rims to y 202, with red aircraft lights at y 203..204. Hall 1 is a 210x224 box with pale piers every 7 blocks and skylight strips, and its south front has a canopy porch, flags and the lettering.
The Hyatt is a beige banded slab with stepped ends and a lit GRAND HYATT crown, over a podium with a porte-cochere. TICC is a dark glass box inside a ring of 3x3 quartz piers under a heavy overhanging roof, with a grand stair on its east front. These are the shapes, colours and lit edges that make each building recognisable from a high south-east view at dusk. Four modern masses built on the architect's grid: ITB bronze-glass tower with a stepped lit crown, a long low pier-and-glass Exhibition Hall, a banded Hyatt slab with a lit sign, and a colonnaded TICC under a deep roof slab.
Facades are produced by repeated helpers (curtain_bay, pier_bay, hotel_band, ticc_pier) with scattered warm and cool froglight backing, so the buildings glow at dusk.
There are 6 parts, split by trade: massing, crown and grounds, then lighting last. Only the lit lobbies count as rooms.

rooms.name: ITB north lobby
rooms.purpose: Double-height lit bronze foyer behind glass: reception desk, warm ochre ceiling light.

rooms.name: ITB south foyer
rooms.purpose: Lit entrance foyer at the shaft's south face, with a seating group.

rooms.name: Hall entrance concourse
rooms.purpose: Long lit glass concourse behind the TWTC porch, with ticket desks and banners.
rooms.ways_in: door pairs in glass wall z258, x245..276, y3..4

rooms.name: Hyatt lobby
rooms.purpose: Grand warm lobby: lounge seating, a reception desk, chandelier lanterns, glowing for the dusk render.

rooms.name: TICC east foyer
rooms.purpose: Lit convention foyer behind the east glass, with registration desks.
rooms.ways_in: doors on east face x697, z52..75, y6..8

parts.name: ITB shell and lobby
parts.scope: Plot 0 plinth y0..4, lobby podium, tower shaft 18..67 x 20..69 y4..182 with chamfers, curtain grid, corner piers, top band and cornice. Uses plinth_fill, curtain_bay, chamfer_corner, lit_lobby_front.

parts.name: ITB crown and plaza
parts.scope: Crown steps y183..197, lit rims, penthouse with louvres, aircraft lights, floodlights, plaza planters with trees, lamp posts and slab ramps. Uses lit_rim, aircraft_light, floodlight, planter_tree, lamp_post, slab_ramp.

parts.name: Exhibition Hall 1
parts.scope: Plot 1: main hall, north block, fringes, pier rhythm, arcade, porch canopy, frieze lettering, flags, skylights, AHU boxes and the NW walkway. Uses pier_bay, arcade_pier, flag_pole, skylight_strip, ahu_box, plaque.

parts.name: Grand Hyatt
parts.scope: Plot 2: podium, tower slab and stepped ends, banded facades, crown with GRAND HYATT sign, penthouse lights, lobby, porte-cochere, wings. Uses hotel_band, lit_lobby_front, aircraft_light, plaque.

parts.name: TICC
parts.scope: Plot 3: terrace plinth, glass hall, colonnade, overhanging roof slab, attic, roof plant, annex and wings, grand east stair, TICC letters. Uses ticc_pier, grand_stair, plaque, lit_lobby_front.

parts.name: Dusk lighting and street
parts.scope: All plots: window_backing scatter (warm and cool clusters), roof_light grid on every roof and terrace, Xinyi Road lamp posts, and lit shopfronts. Run last.

recruit.why: Plinths, granite bases, quartz piers and cornices, with courses and worked edges.
Mullion and spandrel grids, stained glass bays and lit lobby glazing.
Block-font lettering for TAIPEI WORLD TRADE CENTER, GRAND HYATT and TICC.
Dusk lighting: warm and cool window scatter, rims, aircraft lights and roof lights.
Plaza planters, trees, paving and slab approach ramps.
Flat modern roofs with parapets, copings, skylights and plant boxes.
